title: 2026 AMC 8 Problem 13
statement: The figure below shows a tiling of \(1 \times 1\) unit squares. Each row of unit squares is shifted horizontally by half a unit relative to the row above it. A shaded square is drawn on top of the tiling. Each vertex of the shaded square is a vertex of one of the unit squares. In square units, what is the area of the shaded square?

solutions.text: One side of the shaded square goes \(3\) unit widths horizontally and \(1\) unit vertically in the grid. Its length squared is therefore \(3^2+1^2=10\). The area of a square equals its side length squared, so the shaded area is \(10\).
hints: Look at one side of the shaded square
That side moves \(3\) units horizontally and \(1\) unit vertically
